ciReferenceEnvironment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 with TeX Live 2023 packages installed by .github/workflows/verify.yml
pdfPolicy: The public LaTeX source is canonical. CI must compile a valid PDF and publish it as a workflow artifact; PDF bytes are not required to be identical across TeX distributions.
hashPolicy: Manuscript source integrity is checked by recomputing the content-addressed Git blob object ID from each file's bytes.
